mu_name_from: The Dungeon's object slot 14, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, from MuMain, decoded under a dn_ prefix: assets/textures is one flat pool, and wood01 and TileRock01 are other worlds' names too. TileRock01 is byte for byte World2's own, so the rocks wear the ground's copy.
why_this_one: Not a floor slab: an open square rim, 1 m across at the floor and sloping 9 cm out over 17 cm down, with no top face, in deep_wall04's bottom strip. It lines the pits' edges (107.5,120.5 to 111.5,123.5 round one pit), so under the floor it is hidden and at a pit's edge it is the carved lip. The '45 degree tilt' once reported is this chamfer: all 217 placements are square to the grid. Seen in the world 2026-09-30 at 108,124.
material_note: The deep_wall sheets are the Dungeon's masonry: 01, 04, 05, 07 and 08 are dressed stone blocks and friezes and take flagstone; 02 and 03 are carved demon reliefs and 12 dark cracked cave rock, and take rock.
